author: Intel
description:
What is it like to intern at Intel? Join Eva, Caden, and Zane as they share their experiences as Intel interns on our Hillsboro, Oregon campus. 

In this video, they talk about the projects they've worked on, the skills they've developed, the support they've received from their teams, and what surprised them most about their internship journey. 

Hear firsthand how Intel helps students gain meaningful experience, build professional connections, and make an impact from day one.
 
Subscribe now to Intel on YouTube: https://intel.ly/3IX1bN2 
 
About Intel:
Intel, the world leader in silicon innovation, develops technologies, products and initiatives to continually advance how people work and live. Founded in 1968 to build semiconductor memory products, Intel introduced the world's first microprocessor in 1971. This decade, our mission is to create and extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth.

description:
Here's a one-minute breakdown of four things to know about Intel 18A-P, the first derivative of Intel 18A process technology. With improved performance, power efficiency and thermal resistance, Intel 18A-P can enable faster computing and better battery life. Intel 18A-P also introduces Power Boost, a first of its kind dual contact transistor technology.
